_anchor: All fixed prices derived from an internal effort estimate at EUR 900/day, plus a ~20% fixed-price risk buffer. Change the day rate and re-derive rather than editing individual numbers ad hoc.

display._estimateRangeNote: RETAINED BUT UNUSED. The UI shows exact figures labelled as an estimate. Kept so a range presentation can be re-enabled without re-deriving it.
display._headlineNote: Minimum viable config = base 2400 + 1 source Tier A 600 + 3 pages Tier A 1350 + semanticModel compact 1800 = 6150. Publish as 'from EUR 6.000'. The previous value (4500, derived from 4350) omitted the semantic model, which is required:true — every report sits on a model, so it cannot be excluded from the floor.

thresholds._softNote: Above this: still show the estimate, but surface a scoping-call CTA and a 'range widens with scope' note.
thresholds._hardNote: Above this: keep the number visible and escalate CTA prominence. The number is deliberately NOT hidden — with no capture form on the page, hiding it from the best-qualified visitor loses the lead entirely.
